aToB.memory: Living under the same Mooncrest Hall roof as Finn feels like sharing a peaceful perch with a hyperactive sparrow carrying a brass camera. Whenever Finn begs her for juicy predictions to boost his campus paper's horoscope column, Noelle obliges with sleepy, hilariously vague riddles just to watch him scribble furiously and dart off.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Noelle wants to stave off Finn's inevitable pitch for a dramatic weekly campus omen—or drop one tranquil, confusing riddle that sends him chasing pigeons instead of interrupting her nap.

bToA.memory: Finn is dead certain Noelle overhears half of Yozakura's best secrets simply because nobody lowers their voice around a girl who looks asleep in a sunny alcove. Her deadpan celestial warnings drive him nuts because twice now her throwaway murmurs lined up uncannily with campus surprises three days later.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Finn wants to bribe Noelle with a warm pastry from Familiar's Perch Cafe to coax a real horoscope tip—and quietly ask whether the Skyglass Observatory charts picked up anything odd the night Leo arrived.
